title: 무너지는 숲
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished story-stage landscape illustration, without any title or lettering. Opaque wide 16:9 at the largest available landscape resolution, intended for downscaling to 640x360 and display at 360-480px width. Reference 1 is the game's painted pixel-art style anchor; reference 2 is its story painting style; reference 3 is this realm's palette, architecture and landmarks. All are reference inputs, not edit targets. Match the crisp visible painted pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes, rich but controlled colour, layered fantasy depth; no photographic or smooth 3D rendering. Cohesive nine-picture set rules: wide level establishing view, one dominant landmark centred horizontally in the MIDDLE THIRD, skyline/horizon around 70-74% image height in the LOWER THIRD, key environmental light from UPPER LEFT, midtone readability with dark blue-violet shadows, moderate saturation and contrast comparable to the other realms. Simple large shapes readable in a thumbnail. The outermost 3% on every side must be low-detail calm scenery safe for an 8px frame overlap, but DO NOT draw a frame. Keep the entire landmark in view. No people, human faces, humanoid figures, statues, letters, text-like decoration, glyphs, runes, numerals, logo, watermark, UI, borders or frames. No text anywhere. Stage 5, take B. VANAHEIM: vine-clad forest temple, VINE BRIDGES, a floating island BREAKING with glowing ORANGE collapse fissures. Take B: wide three-quarter view of a central tall open temple arch and ruined green spire on an island split into two tilted slabs. A long sagging braided VINE bridge comes in from lower left, another taut vine bridge departs toward right; these must read as living vines with leaves, not stone aqueducts. Orange light shines through a clear diagonal rupture across the island front, several large rocks falling away. Strong recognisable temple remains centred; low distant cloud horizon at y72%, ample uncluttered forest-green sky and layered mist, soft key light from upper left. Deep green and turquoise with amber-orange danger accent. No figures, faces, carved writing, rune stones, idols or animals. LAYOUT PRIORITY over the reference compositions: references supply style and realm identity only. Do NOT repeat their tall busy edge islands or high skyline. Keep the distant horizon unmistakably at y=75% of frame height, leaving the top 70% broad quiet atmospheric space interrupted only by the SINGLE central landmark. All secondary distant ground details remain below y=70%. No elaborate foreground objects at the edges. Main landmark base at y=76%, top near y=28%, visual centre x=50%. Calm outer 8 pixels after downscale.
